title: Determination of the Average Molecular Weight of Hydroxyethyl Starches by Diffusion/hyphenminusOrdered NMR Spectroscopy
abstract: A correlation equation is obtained for the evaluation of the average molecular weight ( MW ) of hydroxyethyl starches from the self/hyphenminusdiffusion coefficient D measured using diffusion/hyphenminusordered NMR spectros/hyphenminus copy. Correlation equations MW = cD -α are compared for hydroxyethyl starches, dextrans, and pullulans. It has been demonstrated that different MWs correspond to constant D values of uncharged polysaccharides with the similar type of nonvalent interactions and different degrees of branching.
